stories.new_fact: AP reported that Trump's Russian diesel deal is drawing congressional criticism over the existing Russian energy import ban, Ukraine-related conditions and an October 18 sanctions timing issue.
stories.new_takeaway: Fuel price relief can collide with sanctions law; fuel buyers, refiners and banks need legal clarity before treating Russian cargo as ordinary supply.
stories.why_now: The AP story and the October 18 sanctions date create a current compliance and market test.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior seven scripts covered Riyadh, Fed independence, FCC disputes and markets, but not the Russian diesel legal dispute.
stories.uncertainty: The administration's legal theory, shipment mechanics, Ukraine response and congressional remedies remain unclear.
stories.watch: Treasury or State guidance, a waiver theory, court action, congressional action, confirmed shipment or October 18 sanctions implementation.

stories.new_fact: NBC4 reported that Pizza Expo Columbus ended Monday at the Greater Columbus Convention Center after drawing about 3,000 pizza shop owners and cooks plus about 2,000 pizza fans.
stories.new_takeaway: A recurring niche trade show can become downtown convention demand and a small-business supplier/margin signal, not merely a consumer event.
stories.why_now: The event wrapped Monday and organizers said they plan to continue it in 2027.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent Columbus segments covered early voting, gas tax, crisis response, housing, weather/event logistics and marathon planning; no pizza expo or downtown trade-show segment.
stories.uncertainty: No public economic-impact number or 2027 contract detail was disclosed.
stories.watch: Whether organizers confirm 2027 dates and whether downtown convention calendars keep adding specialty trade shows.

stories.new_fact: Beginning October 13, all VA refinance loans delivered through the MPF Program must use the new Govt 30 YR VA Refinance subproduct and corresponding VA refinance delivery commitment pricing grid.
stories.new_takeaway: The operational risk is pricing-grid and delivery-routing defects for VA refinance files, not borrower eligibility or a generic rate update.
stories.why_now: The requirement becomes effective on the episode date after the Columbus Day funding pause.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent lending segments covered Freddie delivery, UAD exceptions, Fannie guide updates, rates, MBA credit availability and FHA score implementation; no MPF VA refi delivery segment.
stories.uncertainty: MPF may issue clarifications if participating financial institutions report mapping or pricing issues.
stories.watch: MPF clarifications, reported delivery defects, pricing-grid corrections or broader VA refinance execution changes.

stories.new_fact: IBM announced that Mashreq is piloting IBM Bob for integration engineering, reporting up to a 60%-70% reduction in design and troubleshooting time and about 4,000 AI-agent requests per month through a secure gateway.
stories.new_takeaway: The banking-AI buyer question is whether faster integration design also produces safer deployment quality, not only whether engineers save minutes.
stories.why_now: The announcement was published October 12 and changes the bank AI ledger with a new pilot row.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent bank AI segments covered Upstart, Incognia, Plaid, BNP, MAS and Evident; no Mashreq/IBM integration-engineering row.
stories.uncertainty: Evidence is company/vendor reported; no independent defect-rate, outage, security, customer-impact or regulator-acceptance metric was disclosed.
stories.watch: Production rollout, independent quality evidence, incident-resolution metric, security findings or regulator/customer disclosure.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Mashreq / IBM Bob integration engineering: new pilot row in lane 7 with company/vendor-reported time-saved metric and missing quality controls.

stories.new_fact: Meta launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, with Muse Wonder available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code and Wonder Full limited to Muse Code subscribers.
stories.new_takeaway: Meta's frontier return is actionable only after buyers distinguish version availability, memory behavior, safety evidence and independent workflow results.
stories.why_now: The models launched October 12, within 24 hours of the episode cutoff.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent frontier segments covered OpenAI safety researchers and Anthropic agent failures; no Meta Muse Wonder segment.
stories.uncertainty: Meta's additional safety evaluations were promised but not yet public at cutoff, and benchmark claims remain first-party until third-party workflow replication.
stories.watch: Full safety report publication, independent workflow tests, Wonder Full API access, pricing changes or enterprise-control documentation.
stories.frontier_bar: New capability and access shift for agentic frontier models, with practical workflow implications and safety-evidence gap.

stories.new_fact: Reuters reported Monday that oil touched its highest level in about two weeks, chip stocks fell and investors looked ahead to bank earnings, inflation data and retail sales.
stories.new_takeaway: For borrowers and local finance teams, oil and yields matter more than a mixed stock index when inflation and rate expectations are still live.
stories.why_now: Monday's market setup leads into Tuesday bank earnings and Wednesday CPI.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior episodes covered Friday and Monday market setups; this is kept compact and tied to fresh oil/earnings/CPI timing.
stories.uncertainty: Treasury cash-market signals were limited by the holiday, and market levels can change during Tuesday trading.
stories.watch: Bank earnings credit commentary, Wednesday CPI, retail sales, oil and Treasury yields.

stories.new_fact: The Columbus forecast at cutoff showed partly cloudy early conditions, a high near 87 and a chance to break the old record high for the date, with Wednesday cooler and bringing showers.
stories.new_takeaway: Treat Tuesday like a late-summer day and use the dry window before Wednesday showers.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine daily weather; the record-warm day differs from yesterday's fog/warm setup.
stories.uncertainty: Record-high and shower timing can shift with updated forecasts.
stories.watch: Wednesday shower timing and any heat-related local advisories.

editorial_review.notes: Compared facts and conclusions against Oct. 6-12 scripts. Avoided third consecutive Riyadh/FHA/Anthropic carryover without a materially different trigger. Home lending leads with an MPF VA refinance delivery workflow and consequence. Banking AI updates a ledger row with a named pilot, baseline and limitation. Frontier AI updates the tracker with Meta Muse Wonder while separating Meta claims from independent evidence. Closing has exactly three watch items.
